title: Pure Genex
summary: Pure Genex Synchro build featuring the 2024 Terminal World wave, generic Synchros, and staples. Because the classic Genex searchers trigger on Normal Summon with no once-per-turn clause, Repair Genex Controller turns any single Normal Summon into an endless chain of searches and extra Normal Summons.

summary.title: Starters
points: R-Genex Magma searches a Level 2 R-Genex monster (such as R-Genex Overseer or R-Genex Turing) when Normal Summoned.
R-Genex Crusher searches a Level 4 R-Genex monster (R-Genex Undine, R-Genex Accelerator, or R-Genex Ultimum) when Normal Summoned.

R-Genex Turbo searches a Level 1 Genex monster (R-Genex Oracle or Genex Recycled) when Normal Summoned, while Genex Power Planner searches a Level 3 Genex Effect Monster and Genex Undine sends a WATER monster from Deck to GY to add Genex Controller.

summary.title: Opening: Any Level 4 or Lower Genex into Repair Genex Controller
steps: Normal Summon R-Genex Magma (or Crusher/Turbo) to search a Genex monster, then use that monster to Link Summon Link-1 Repair Genex Controller.
Trigger Repair Genex Controller on Link Summon to add Magma back from the GY to your hand.

Because a Genex monster was added from the GY to your hand, Repair Genex Controller immediately triggers its second effect (which has no once-per-turn limit!) to Normal Summon a Genex monster from your hand.

Chain Normal Summons of Magma, Crusher, Turbo, R-Genex Undine, and R-Genex Overseer—summoning R-Genex Oracle for free when searched—to Synchro climb into Arms of Genex Return Zero and Locomotion R-Genex.

summary.title: Repair Genex Controller & Tuner Engine
summary.text: Once Repair Genex Controller grants its extra Normal Summon, you cannot Special Summon from the Extra Deck for the rest of the turn except by Synchro Summon using a Genex Tuner as material. R-Genex Undine banishes a Genex from your GY to gain its Attribute and treat itself as a Tuner, or recovers 2 Genex monsters from the GY (including itself). R-Genex Turing Special Summons itself during the opponent's Main Phase while you control a Genex monster and immediately Synchro Summons a Genex Synchro Monster.

summary.title: Synchro Bosses & Payoff
points: Arms of Genex Return Zero (3100 ATK) banishes a monster from your GY with the same Attribute as an opponent's monster that activated its effect to negate and destroy it—with no once-per-turn limit, up to once per Attribute if you load multiple Attributes in the GY—and returns up to 6 Genex monsters of different Attributes from your GY/banishment to the Deck to destroy that many Spells and Traps.
Locomotion R-Genex permanently takes control of the opponent's monster with the highest Level on Synchro Summon.

Genex Ally Triforce, Genex Ally Triarm, Thermal Genex, and Hydro Genex unlock bonus effects based on the Attributes of their materials, while Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon provides an extra monster negate.
